sources.claim: The Probability of Bankruptcy for Frontier Group Holdings Inc (FYBR) is 49.95% in the next 24 months.
The Probability of Bankruptcy for Frontier Group Holdings Inc (ULCC) is 45.74% in the next 24 months.
ULCC Altman Z-Score is 0.38 as of Feb. 13, 2026, in the distress zone (<1.8), indicating bankruptcy possibility in the next two years.
Altman Z-score interpretation: Z>3 safe; 1.8-3 grey; Z<1.8 distress; historical predictive accuracy around 72-80% two years ahead, 90% one year ahead.
Frontier Group Holdings announces webcast of Q4 2025 financial results; company remains active and reporting.

As of March 31, 2025, Frontier had total liquidity of approximately $2.6 billion, including cash of $0.5 billion, with no long-term debt maturities prior to 2027; a merger with Verizon is expected to close by the first quarter of 2026.

As of March 31, 2025, future maturities of debt include $209 million in 2025, $120 million in 2026, $4 million in 2027, $9 million in 2028, and $93 million in 2029; total debt principal payments $512 million; no repayments due before 2027 beyond the 2025/2026 amounts.
Frontier Group Holdings (ULCC) has an Altman Z-Score of 0.38, in the distress zone, implying bankruptcy possibility in the next two years.
Independent studies of the Altman Z-score found that the model would have predicted between 72% and 80% of actual bankruptcies two years in advance.
Altman Z-score interpretation: Z > 3 is safe; Z < 1.8 is distress (with a gray zone between 1.8 and 3).
Spirit Airlines filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, illustrating sector distress patterns that could affect peers in the airline industry.
